mechanism: When a monotone continuation update hits the cached optimal plan, search the old zero-reduced-cost transport graph after removing updated edges. If that graph still carries the marginals, an alternative old-optimal plan avoids the update and certifies the updated local OT value without solving the new weighted OT.
omitted_computation: Full updated-cost OT solves replaced by sparse feasibility flow on the cached optimal face; H_D01 support-miss reuse remains the cheaper first gate.
assumptions: Fixed local marginals and nonnegative continuation-cost update
All dual-tight edges needed for the old optimal face are represented conservatively
Failed face feasibility falls back to the same exact OT kernel
Face construction, feasibility flow, caching and fallback are fully charged
lemma_or_invariant: An updated optimum keeps the old value exactly iff the old optimal face contains a feasible plan supported on zero-update edges. Old dual-tight plus zero-update edges characterize a sufficient feasibility problem; any returned plan has the unchanged old primal-dual value and is optimal after the update.

nearest_prior_art.topic: min-cost-flow sensitivity, complementary slackness and reoptimization
nearest_prior_art.remaining_question: Whether optimal-face feasibility is cheaper on the update patterns generated by adapted-OT tree recursion

prediction: After H_D01 misses on declared degenerate fixtures, optimal-face reuse skips at least 25% additional full OT solves and uses fewer tested edges than the corresponding full transport constraint count, with every accepted value matching fresh OT within 1e-9.
falsification_rule: Any false acceptance is implementation_invalid. Failure of skip/work thresholds rejects only this face-reuse mechanism on the declared update family and implies no general impossibility.

probe.oracle: Fresh OT audits decisions only after execution.
probe.cost_accounting: Charge reduced-cost edge tests, zero-update tests, feasibility-flow variables/nonzeros, witness replay, cache/index work and fallback weighted OT on an identical update trace.

breadth_challenge: Fixture screen must include both costs, k=1/2, unique and degenerate optima, zero masses, unavoidable updates and recombining trees before any stochastic grid.
ablation: Fresh OT; dynamic OT reoptimization; H_D01 support-miss only; H_D01 plus optimal-face repair.
unresolved_objections: The method may be standard min-cost-flow sensitivity with no novelty
Enumerating the dual-tight graph may be dense
Feasibility flow may cost as much as updated OT
Numerical tight-edge classification needs outward error control
